title: 蓝智零售分析师：AI代理购物，2030年将达5000亿美元
speaker: Guest

segments.en: Absolutely. So when you think about e-commerce sales today, most of them happen through your mobile app, you browsing and buying them directly. Agentic has a few different ways. You could look at it. One is fully agentic and one is semi-agentic.
segments.zh: 当然。如今电商销售大多通过手机应用直接浏览购买。代理式有几种方式：完全代理和半代理。

segments.en: So the $500 billion number that you refer to is fully agentic. That means you go into an agent and you say, I'd like to buy a black dress for Prime. Let's just say that's your query. That's all you have to say.
segments.zh: 你提到的5000亿美元是指完全代理。你只需对代理说，我想买一条黑色连衣裙，仅此而已。

segments.en: One prompt and it knows where you want to buy it. It knows how much you want to spend and it knows how soon you need it and it just ships to your door. Now, is that going to happen for that black dress for Prime? Probably not.
segments.zh: 一个指令，它就知道在哪里买、花多少钱、多快送到，然后直接发货。但黑色连衣裙可能不会这样。

segments.en: But will it happen for your laundry detergent, for your gallon of milk, for your tools, for your tires? Sure. So replenishment items are a big part of the fully agentic equation, but semi-agentic, which is when you use an AI agent to talk back and forth to like Amazon Alexa for shopping.
segments.zh: 但洗衣液、牛奶、工具、轮胎呢？当然。补充型商品是完全代理的重要部分，而半代理则是与Alexa等AI代理对话购物。

segments.en: It's when you engage the agent to search for something. For example, when you use Alexa for shopping, you go ahead and say, I want this power washer, for example, and find me the best power washer and needs to wash this many square feet and needs to have AI abilities, et cetera.
segments.zh: 半代理是让代理搜索商品。比如用Alexa购物，你说我想要高压清洗机，找到最好的，能清洗这么多平方英尺，具备AI功能等。

segments.en: And it needs to be under $500. Today, it's $650. When it drops to 500, I should have it. And it just happened in three weeks when it drops, you'll have it at your door.
segments.zh: 价格需低于500美元，现在650美元，降到500时我就买。三周后降价，你就能收到。

segments.en: So that's semi-agentic. And we think over 60% of transactions in key commerce in 2030 will have an agent involved in one way or another.
segments.zh: 这就是半代理。我们预计到2030年，超过60%的关键电商交易将有代理参与。

segments.en: Putting oil, hitting on what Christine, I know has been searching for that power washer that you've had your AI on for many months now. I could find something to power wash.
segments.zh: 说到Christine，我知道她一直在找高压清洗机，AI已经关注几个月了。我总能找到需要清洗的东西。

segments.en: You don't know my life. Some amount of spare food in your apartment needs to be power washed, I'm sure.
segments.zh: 你不了解我的生活。你公寓里肯定有需要清洗的东西。
